final_case_construction_limitations: This is candidate-policy replay, not end-to-end quality evaluation.
Alternative acceptance changes the case state and therefore later prompts and candidate pools; final cases cannot be counterfactually reconstructed from the observed pool.
A selected winner can leave a sibling cancelled, unfinished, or completed after cancellation without deterministic evaluation or a typed critic outcome.
Publish enrichment candidates are not generator acceptance candidates and are outside these three arms.
Seed candidates have deterministic certification but no typed model-critic stage, so the full policy is not evaluable for them.
identical_pool_rule: All policies are evaluated over the same retained C3 candidate rows, in logical-request order.

policies.deterministic_code_kernel_refinement: Accept iff the same retained candidate passed parsing and the recorded deterministic code/kernel/refinement laws.
policies.full_kernel_typed_model_critic: For refinement candidates, accept iff deterministic checks passed and the retained typed critic outcome is PASS. Seed candidates are not evaluable because the online design has no seed critic.
policies.structurally_parseable_llm_only: Accept a retained response iff it parses to a JSON object. Parsing is retained only for schema/safety handling; no code, kernel, refinement-law, or critic judgment is applied.
